NHANES 2001-2002 gait speed and mobility items, ages 60+

Source: R/data.R
pf_gait.Rd

Gait speed from the timed 20-ft walk and seven lower-body mobility items of the physical functioning questionnaire for NHANES 2001-2002 participants aged 60+ with a valid walk time and at least one item answered. Analyses are unweighted. [gait_data()] returns these data, optionally filtered or recoded, together with the item matrix.

Usage

pf_gait

Format

A data frame with 1426 rows and 15 columns:

SEQN

NHANES respondent sequence number

age

age in years at screening (60 to 85; 85 = 85 or older)

sex

1 = male, 2 = female

walk_time

time to walk 20 ft, seconds

gait_speed

gait speed, m/s (6.096 m / walk_time)

walking_aid

1 = walking-aid user (needs special equipment to walk, used a device in the walk test, or could not walk unassisted), 0 = not

C1

difficulty walking a quarter mile (0 = no difficulty, 1 = some, 2 = much, 3 = unable; NA if missing or not asked)

C2

difficulty walking up 10 steps (coded as C1)

C3

difficulty walking between rooms on the same floor (coded as C1)

C4

difficulty standing up from an armless chair (coded as C1)

C5

difficulty getting in and out of bed (coded as C1)

C6

difficulty stooping, crouching or kneeling (coded as C1)

C7

difficulty standing for long periods (coded as C1)

n_items_answered

number of items C1 to C7 answered (1 to 7)

needs_equipment

1 = needs special equipment to walk (PFQ055 = 1); C1 and C2 are not asked of these people

Source

NHANES 2001-2002 public-use files MSX_B (lower extremity functioning), PFQ_B (physical functioning) and DEMO_B (demographics), National Center for Health Statistics, <https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/>. Built by `inst/scripts/gait_data.R`.
